title: Complicated Vehicle Systems and Integration
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G70's systems and computer integration as overly complicated, with some fragments too brief to confirm a clear sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the vehicle's systems feel too complicated, making simple tasks harder and sometimes feeling difficult relative to other vehicles or for older users.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention system integration, comparisons to other systems, or computer systems, but they do not provide enough context to confirm a clear evaluation.

limitations: The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 reviews.
Several undetermined fragments are too short or incomplete to identify a specific issue beyond general references to systems or integration.
This topic is fairly coherent around system complexity, but some fragments are vague and do not specify which features or interfaces caused the difficulty.
